info.title: NASA SPHEREx Explorer API
info.description: Complete scientific backend for exploring NASA/IPAC IRSA SPHEREx Level-2 Multi-Extension FITS data, 102-band infrared spectrophotometry, interactive 3-graph spectral comparisons, WCS difference imaging, variance-weighted stacking, 6-month Time-Lapse GIF animations, moving object isolation, and Gaia DR3 / AllWISE / CSA NEOSSat multi-mission overlays.
